title: Music reopens on the provider and view the instructor last used
acceptance: After choosing Apple Music and leaving Music, coming back shows Apple Music in the same view.
A first visit opens on a connected provider when there is one, not the first provider in PROVIDER_ORDER.
A remembered provider that is now disconnected falls back to a connected one with no error.
Remembering uses per-viewer state that survives private mode failing (no hard dependency on storage).

evidence.summary: selectedProvider starts at PROVIDER_ORDER[0] (SoundCloud) and is not persisted; a disconnected provider defaults to Catalog. Checked on main c9b89a7.
2026-10-28 owner UX audit of production: Top priority 8 and the walkthrough re-check that the choice resets after leaving Music. Browser evidence; not re-observed at intake.
Owner set Ready on 2026-10-31, relayed from the Air conductor: "Yes, approve both" (RF-137 and RF-135). No separate Ready PR; this lane PR records it.

MusicView (provider + shelf) in music-library.ts: resolveMusicProvider keeps a remembered service while connected (or when none is), else the first connected in PROVIDER_ORDER; resolveMusicKind restores a shelf the service still offers. Dashboard keeps the view in state (outlives the Music mount) and best-effort localStorage keyed by user; MusicWorkspace resolves once when connections first settle, and a chip tap settles it. providers.ts unchanged.

Four RF-137 tests fail on main eaec1d3 and pass on the PR: Apple Music Songs survives leaving Music; a first visit opens on the connected Apple Music; a remembered disconnected Apple Music falls back to connected Spotify with no alert; with storage throwing, the choice survives leaving Music. Two existing tests narrowed to the service-chip group because Music now opens on the only connected service. music-library.test.ts covers resolve, round-trip per user, malformed values and blocked storage. jsdom component tests; not a real-browser check.

Final review (/code-review medium 672) on b9674b7: one correctness bug, fixed in the same PR: a failed first connections load latched the provisional service, so a successful Retry never picked a connected one. Resolution now waits for a ready load; new test "picks a connected service after a failed first load is retried" fails before and passes after. isConnected now shared with libraryKindFor. Logged in RF-162, not fixed: an OAuth return opens the remembered view rather than the just-connected service when Reconnect came from a non-selected chip; an expired remembered service falls back like a disconnected one.

resolution: Music reopens on the last service and shelf (RF-137, #672). All four criteria are covered by component and unit tests; full local gate (incl. e2e smoke) green on 2026-10-31. No real-browser check beyond the e2e smoke.
